title: Civil Procedure Code (Amendment)
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE CIVIL, PROCEDURE CODE

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

body.heading: Amendment.
body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Civil Procedure Code (Amendment) Act, No. 12 of 1996.
body.text: This Act may be cited as the Civil Procedure Code (Amendment) Act, No. 12 of 1996.

body.heading: Amendment of section 502 of Chapter 101.
body.raw_text: 2. Section 502 of the Civil Procedure Code is hereby amended the substitution for the words "twenty-one years", of the words "eighteen years".
body.text: Section 502 of the Civil Procedure Code is hereby amended the substitution for the words "twenty-one years", of the words "eighteen years".

body.heading: Sinhala text to prevail in case of inconsistency.
body.raw_text: 3. In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text Shall prevail.
body.text: In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text Shall prevail.
